name: The same number of senators voted for and against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-09-07.29.1) to an original amendment. Because no majority was reached, the vote failed. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > > *"and, in respect of the provisions of the [Water Amendment (Restoring our Rivers) Bill 2023](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7076), the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee report by 14 November 2023".* ### Original amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add: "and, in respect of the Water Amendment (Restoring Our Rivers) Bill 2023, the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee report on 8 November 2023."*
